description: This PHP source file defines the BasicUserRoleManager class, which extends AbstractUserRoleManager and manages user roles, permissions, and access control within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for initializing role mappings, checking access permissions, filtering roles, and retrieving entity data based on roles.

classes.name: BasicUserRoleManager
classes.description: This class manages user roles, permissions, and access controls in the OrangeHRM system, initializing predefined roles and providing methods for access validation, role filtering, data retrieval, and page management based on roles.

methods.name: _init
methods.description: Initializes the role-to-class mapping with predefined roles and their corresponding class objects.

methods.name: getUserRoleClass
methods.description: Retrieves a specific user role class instance by role name.

methods.name: getScreenPermissionService
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns the ScreenPermissionService instance.

methods.name: setScreenPermissionService
methods.description: Sets the ScreenPermissionService instance.

methods.name: getHomePageDao
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns the HomePageDao instance.

methods.name: setHomePageDao
methods.description: Sets the HomePageDao instance.

methods.name: getAccessFlowStateMachineService
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns the AccessFlowStateMachineService instance.

methods.name: getAccessibleEntities
methods.description: Retrieves entities accessible by the current user based on roles and permissions (not implemented).

methods.name: getAccessibleEntityProperties
methods.description: Retrieves properties of entities accessible by the current user (not implemented).

methods.name: getAccessibleEntityIds
methods.description: Retrieves IDs of entities accessible by the current user.

methods.name: isActionAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a specific action is allowed in a given workflow state.

methods.name: getAllowedActions
methods.description: Lists allowed actions for the user in a specific workflow and state.

methods.name: getActionableStates
methods.description: Returns states where specified actions can be applied by the user.

methods.name: getUniqueActionsBasedOnPriority
methods.description: Filters workflow actions to keep only the highest priority action per action name.

methods.name: isEntityAccessible
methods.description: Checks if a specific entity is accessible by the user.

methods.name: areEntitiesAccessible
methods.description: Checks if multiple entities are accessible by the user.

methods.name: getEmployeesWithRole
methods.description: Retrieves employees assigned to a specific role.

methods.name: getAccessibleModules
methods.description: Not implemented; would retrieve modules accessible to the user.

methods.name: isModuleAccessible
methods.description: Not implemented; checks if module access is permitted.

methods.name: isScreenAccessible
methods.description: Not implemented; checks if a specific screen is accessible.

methods.name: isFieldAccessible
methods.description: Not implemented; checks if a specific field is accessible.

methods.name: getScreenPermissions
methods.description: Retrieves permissions for a specific screen.

methods.name: getApiPermissions
methods.description: Retrieves API permissions for a given class.

methods.name: computeUserRoles
methods.description: Computes roles for a user, including supervisor and special roles based on entities.

methods.name: areRequiredPermissionsAvailable
methods.description: Checks if required permissions are available for a role.

methods.name: mergeEmployees
methods.description: Merges two employee lists, avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: filterRoles
methods.description: Filters roles based on inclusion/exclusion lists and entity context.

methods.name: isSupervisorFor
methods.description: Checks whether the current user is supervisor for a given employee.

methods.name: isProjectAdmin
methods.description: Checks if an employee is a project admin.

methods.name: isHiringManager
methods.description: Checks if an employee is a hiring manager.

methods.name: isInterviewer
methods.description: Checks if an employee is an interviewer.

methods.name: getDataGroupService
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns the DataGroupService instance.

methods.name: getDataGroupPermissions
methods.description: Retrieves data group permissions for roles.

methods.name: getDataGroupPermissionCollection
methods.description: Retrieves the collection of data group permissions based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getModuleDefaultPage
methods.description: Determines default page for a module based on user roles and enable checks.

methods.name: getHomePage
methods.description: Determines the home page for the current user based on roles and enable checks.

methods.name: fixUserRoleNameForWorkflowStateMachine
methods.description: Adjusts role names for workflow contexts, e.g., 'ESS' or 'HiringManager'.

methods.name: getAccessibleQuickLaunchList
methods.description: Retrieves list of accessible quick launch items based on roles.
